title: Polynomial Link Invariants via Decategorification of Subquandle Quiver Filtrations
summary: In this paper, we introduce the notion of subquandle filtrations for finite quandles as a foundation to construct algebraic and combinatorial link invariants. A nested sequence of subquandles naturally induces a filtration of the associated quandle coloring quiver by subquivers. By decategorifying these subquivers, we define two new polynomial-valued invariants of links: the disrespectful polynomial and the graded disrespectful polynomial, which measure how a chosen set of quandle endomorphisms respects and disrespects subquandle structure.
